title: It can see now
summary: Show a photo to a model running on your phone, hear back when replies land, and feel every tap.

items.title: Models that see
items.text: Gemma 4 and Gemma 3n in Pocket Lab now look at the photos you attach and answer about them, entirely on your phone.

items.title: Notifications that matter
items.text: Leave the app while Neru works. You’ll hear when a reply is ready, a desktop session needs you or finishes, or your team is done.

items.title: Haptics, your way
items.text: Gentle taps when you send, switch and confirm, with a switch in Settings to turn them off.

items.title: Check for updates
items.text: Settings has an Updates section to look for a new version any time. Downloads in Pocket Lab also retry on their own when the connection drops.

items.title: Neru, through and through
items.text: Confirmations and permission prompts now use Neru’s own sheets, and the welcome screens are calmer without the glow.

title: Team in your pocket
summary: Start Team tasks from your phone, watch them in a calmer thread, and get every new version as soon as it ships.

items.title: Start a task from anywhere
items.text: Pick the agents and models on your computer, choose a project, and send the first message. @-mention any member as you type.

items.title: A tidier Team
items.text: Members sit in a scrollable strip with their real logos, and replies are grouped by author with clear names and times.

items.title: Updates find you
items.text: When a new version of Neru is out, it offers itself the moment you open the app, with the highlights and a one-tap download.

items.title: Smoother everywhere
items.text: Messages fly up like iMessage, conversations load behind a soft shimmer, and the sidebar switches between chats and your desktop with icons.

items.title: A glow that listens
items.text: The voice glow now follows your actual speaking volume, rising and falling with every word.

title: Meet Pocket Lab
summary: Make room for models that run on your phone, and stay close to your desktop wherever you connect.

items.title: A lab in your pocket
items.text: Explore the 10 models from Google AI Edge Gallery. Download models, then run them offline on Android with your own prompts and settings.

items.title: A little Magic Touch
items.text: Tap an object in a photo to create a transparent cutout, entirely on your phone.

items.title: Code or Team
items.text: Choose a desktop Code session or Team conversation. Send follow-ups while work is running, and jump to the latest reply when you’re ready.

items.title: Across networks
items.text: Enable internet access in desktop Phone settings to connect from another Wi-Fi network or mobile data. Keep Neru open and your desktop awake.

items.title: A steadier voice glow
items.text: The listening animation stays inside your prompt, with a stable rendering surface as the text grows.

title: Neru, now on your phone
summary: Chat with free models wherever you are, and keep an eye on the work Neru is doing on your computer.

items.title: Free models that keep going
items.text: Add a free key from NVIDIA, Google, OpenRouter and others. When a model runs out, Neru moves to the next one.

items.title: Your desktop, in your pocket
items.text: Scan the code in Neru on your computer to follow sessions, read diffs, approve changes and reply.

items.title: Just say it
items.text: Tap the mic and talk. The glow around the message box listens with you.

items.title: Photos and files
items.text: Attach pictures and documents, and tap any picture to see it full screen.

items.title: Never miss an approval
items.text: Neru tells you when a desktop session is waiting on you.
